newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Kindercare indication up 3 to 19.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Kindercare indication up 3 to 19.

text.p: Except for a buy indication for KinderCare Learning Centers Inc of 19, up three points from the close, stocks stayed in line with the market close after hours on Thursday, traders said.

KinderCare, which did not actually trade because it became unavailable, announced that it reached a definitive agreement to be acquired by Kohlbergh Kravis Roberts for $20.25 per share in cash after the market closed.
The New York Stock Exchange said Parker-Hannifin Corp, Sparton Corp and Dole Food Co were also unavialable for after hours trade for news.
The NYSE said session one volume was 337,000 shares, compared to 1,300 shares Wednesday. Session two volume was 76,676 versus 840,600.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
